## Requirements

###### Must:

\- We are looking for substantial experience building, training, and productionising machine learning models at scale, including modern deep learning and large language model approaches.
\- We need deep production Python experience and strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, event-driven architectures, and observability.
\- We require strong mathematical and statistical foundations, with the ability to apply techniques rigorously and defensibly.
\- We are looking for experience leading the architectural design of MLOps platforms, including training pipelines, feature and vector stores, serving infrastructure, and drift and performance monitoring.
\- We need experience with cloud platforms such as GCP and AWS, containerised infrastructure including Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, and Argo Workflows, event brokers such as Kafka, and modern data engineering workflows including batch, streaming, and ETL.
\- We are looking for experience turning scientific or product briefs into ML work that ships and delivers measurable value, while pushing back where feasibility, data quality, or risk make goals unrealistic.
\- We need excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and engineers and produce actionable technical documentation.
\- We are looking for a track record of coaching ML engineers at every level and helping Recruiting improve the hiring process.
\- Nice to have: experience applying ML, LLMs, and agentic AI in AML, KYC, fraud, RegTech, or another regulated domain.
\- Nice to have: familiarity with knowledge graphs, entity resolution, link analysis, and temporal reasoning over relationship data.
\- Nice to have: experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM and agentic systems, including safety, accuracy, and operational guardrails.
\- Nice to have: an external profile in the ML community, such as speaking at conferences, contributing to publications, or open-source projects.

## Technologies

Agentic AIAI [AWS](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/AWS/all "AWS Jobs United Kingdom") ArgoCD [Backend](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Backend/all "Backend Jobs United Kingdom") CI/CD [Cloud](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Cloud/all "Cloud Jobs United Kingdom") [Docker](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Docker/all "Docker Jobs United Kingdom") ES6 [ETL](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/ETL/all "ETL Jobs United Kingdom") [Frontend](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Frontend/all "Frontend Jobs United Kingdom") [GCP](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/GCP/all "GCP Jobs United Kingdom") [Grafana](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Grafana/all "Grafana Jobs United Kingdom") [Support](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Support/all "Support Jobs United Kingdom") [Kafka](https://devitjobs.uk/jobs/Kafka/all "Kafka Jobs United Kingdom")

## Responsibilities

\- We lead the architectural design and implementation of our company-wide MLOps and agentic AI platforms, covering training, evaluation, serving, feature and vector stores, and agent orchestration.
\- We translate the ML and agentic AI roadmaps into scalable engineering deliverables, ensuring production builds adhere to data governance frameworks and compliance standards.
\- We set the engineering bar across the organization for code quality, rigorous evaluation design, operational standards, and CI/CD pipelines.
\- We lead the end-to-end engineering build-out of AI systems pioneered and prototyped by Data Science, including LLMs, retrieval augmented generation, multi-agent systems, and graph neural networks.
\- We represent ComplyAdvantage at conferences and industry forums.
\- We coach ML engineers at every level and help improve the hiring process.

## Description

We are a company focused on combating financial crime through AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem. Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime, helping customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and regulatory trust. More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our platform, and our agentic automation helps organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff. We are headquartered in London with global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. We offer equity participation, unlimited time off, a hybrid approach with two office days per week, collaboration and career development opportunities, an annual learning budget, a home office budget, enhanced parental leave and childcare benefits, life insurance and medical coverage through BUPA including pre-existing conditions, and pension contribution through The Peoples Pension.
